result.label: bug
result.what_to_change: In parseStatement, only one trailing empty string (from the final newline) is popped from `lines`; a statement with a genuine blank line after the last transaction leaves an extra empty line that gets parsed as a 1-field row and fails assertShape. Strip all trailing blank lines (or skip blank lines while iterating rows) instead of popping just the last one.
result.evidence: parser.ts does `if (lines.length > 0 && lines[lines.length - 1] === "") lines.pop();` which removes only a single trailing empty entry; a file ending with 'last line\n\n' splits into [...,'last line','', ''], so after one pop there is still a blank line at the end that is fed to splitFields/assertShape and throws errors.rowShape, matching the reported 'Malformed row' at the line past the last transaction.

not_searched: src/ingest/schema.ts (type conversion step, not relevant to this bug)
